BOSS BATTLE\nWin the battle against Seele Zauga!!
Is that also a god shrine? It's kinda small though.
Oh!! That's...
As expected. The goddess of species, Specia's\nshrine was built separately!\nJust as described in the inscription!
...You dunno who the goddess of species is?\nLikewise.\nWill you tell us?
Seriously you dunno?\nShe's the goddess that has the closest relation\nto us, you know?!
So?
Listen, Specia the Goddess of Species is the one\nwho created us humans, animals, plants, and every\nsingle life form in this world.
She was believed to be so beautiful that\nthe rivalry between male gods in order to win her\nheart was said to have triggered a battle.
Specia was extremely sad because many people were\nkilled in the fight, so she took her own life.
Oh? Mom was right...\nThere are humans here...
Welcome to the Shrine of the Gods, or should we\ncall it ruins now...You made it here after risking\nyour lives. I'm Seele Zauga, Specia's daughter...
Specia's daughter...?\nJudging from your fashion, I find it hard to\nbelieve, though.
What?! Oh no, are they too lame?\nUgggh, I knew it!! I was trying to dress like mom,\nbut it doesn't suit me after all!!
I've actually fixed them to look like my everyday\nclothes...
I've actually fixed them to look like my everyday\nclothes...Oh, what did you just make me say!
Something's coming this wayyy!!
What do you mean you're Specia's daughter...?
*Ahem...My mom, the goddess of species created\nvarious life forms in this world during the fight\nbefore she took her own life & I was one of them.
But I was born imperfect and she died right after\nI was born...
Since then, I told myself that she'd abandoned me\nand I began living as a monster that threatens\nhuman life by absorbing their life energy...
Then someone advised me and introduced me to my\nmom who has become a resident of Noieverre,\na world of a higher dimension than this world.
And as mom's daughter, from a monster, I became\nNoieverre's resident and at the same time mom's\nmessenger that travels between the two worlds...
T-that story, I've heard it from Grandma Ryano!!\nSo it was real...I thought it was just a legend.\nAnd you were that monster? Hmm...
Oh, stap it! I told ya I was imperfect and ugly\nback then!\nSo don't judge me like that!!
...By the way, you said your mom told you there\nare humans here, does that mean you knew we were\ncoming?
Yup. My mother said some humans are coming to\nthese ruins and she wants me to convey her message\nto you...
What is it...?
Well, she asked me to relay her message to you,\nbut since the content is very important, I'm kinda\nskeptical whether I should tell you or not...
But since you managed to get here,\nyou must be quite skilled, I suppose...
...Right. The fastest way to find out about it is\nthrough a battle!
All right, got it!\nI won't go easy on you, you know!!
Wow wow wow! Wait a second!!
Oh nooooo!!
Whew! You're quite something...
Whew! You're quite something...\n*Ahem. Well done.\nI think it's safe to relay mom's message to you...
Phew! I thought I was gonna die...
Phew! I thought I was gonna die...\nTerrible! Don't get a frail archaeologist like me\ninvolved in such an intense battle!
Normally no men would say they are weak...
Exactly! I thought you were strong too like them.\nWhat a bummer!
Aw, you guys got me involved in the fight and\nbesides ending up miserable like this, you guys\nsaid such horrible stuff to me...
Oops, sorry. Right, I need to tell you the message.\nI'm about to tell you what my mother, Specia, who\ncame rushing from Noieverre saw during the cataclysm.
She came back through this shrine after sensing\nsth unusual & she saw the gods were in a big hurry\nto put together the world that had fallen apart...
Did she help them?
The residents of Noieverre are not allowed to\ninterfere with what happens to this world unless\nit's a case of extreme emergency...
She was watching the whole process and only came\nback to Noieverre after making sure that they\nmade it...
But you didn't reveal anything new.\nEveryone knows about that story...
I know, just bear with me for a second!\nHere's the important part!
I know, just bear with me for a second! Here's the\nimportant part! After a while, mom noticed the\nshrine had been overwhelmed by some unprecedented
evil existence, so she came here once again and\nthe shrine's condition was as what you see now...
Does she know why it turned out like this?
Nope. It was already like this when she got here\nand all the gods were nowhere to be found...
So the gods' whereabouts are also...
Yup, unknown.\nThough mother said she could slightly feel their\nenergy, except one god's.
Which god?
What?\nThere's nothing except some stuff like debris\nin the air though...
C-could it be...A-Almas?\nThe chief god residing in the uppermost shrine?
...Exactly...
T-t-that's...oh my my...that's bad, isn't it?!\nIf there are no gods, this world will...
W-wait a second! If the chief god died along with\nthe collapse of the shrine, the world would have\ncollapsed too...Just what exactly is going on...?
According to mom, the gods escaped from the evil\nbeing and hiding themselves while joining their\npower to keep this world attached...
I-is the situation really that bad?!\nOh my god!
...Now you understand the situation?\nSorry for talking too long, now to my mom's\nmessage...
Recently, my mother sensed the same presence of\nevil being coming from somewhere else...
Where?
The huge tree up there where the land of the Elves\nused to be...The entire tree is being overwhelmed\nby the evil existence...
A huge tree...!! E-Eldenbaum!!
Whaaat?!
I want you to pin it down and make it show itself.\nEliminate it! That way we should be able to\nfind out the gods' whereabouts...
That's the message from my mom for you...
First, King Elbano's country got taken over, then\nthere was the Empire of Lyark and Venena's hideout.\nNow it's being overwhelmed by evil existence...
Why did everything have to happen in Eldenbaum...?
Wait! Returning through the same route you took to\nget here will take too much time...
You should be able to return to your world and\nreach Eldenbaum from the Hall of Special Gods...\nPlease be careful...
